reported.title: Pressure conversion omits 500 mV zero offset
reported.description: millivoltsToKpa() at line 25 divides the raw millivolt value by MV_PER_KPA without subtracting the 500 mV zero offset, so every reading is inflated by 50 kPa. The measured evidence shows printed 84.1 kPa while injected was 26.1 to 34.8 kPa (off by 49.3 kPa), and printed 127.1 kPa while injected was 62.2 to 77.5 kPa (off by 49.6 kPa), consistent with the missing (mv - 500) term. Firmware printed 84.1 kPa at 2.01 s while the injected input was 26.08 to 34.75 kPa: off by 49.3 kPa (tolerance ±2). 11 of 11 values were wrong.

reported.title: Gauge lamp driven from offset-corrupted pressure
reported.description: updateGauge() at line 42 compares lastKpa against WARN_KPA, but lastKpa comes from the offset-less conversion at line 70, so the lamp lights at roughly 400 mV (true 0 kPa) instead of 1400 mV (90 kPa). The measured evidence shows D12 not LOW for 1499 ms while required and 2180 ms while required, i.e. the lamp is lit far below the true 90 kPa threshold. D12 was in the wrong state for 2879 ms across 5 interval(s), first at 1.00 s: D12 was not LOW for 389 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

judge_input.spec:
- Pressure transducer on A2 scaled at 10 mV/kPa with a 500 mV zero offset; high-pressure gauge lamp on D12.
- Physical pressure in kPa equals (millivolts − 500) / 10 using a 5.000 V / 1023 ADC span.
- Emit `kPa: <value>` once every 1000 ms with one decimal place.
- Printed pressure must match the injected value within ±2.0 kPa.
- Drive D12 HIGH when pressure is at or above 90.0 kPa; otherwise LOW.
- Continue logging at the same rate while the gauge lamp is lit.
